requirements.requirement: The system must include unit tests that validate correct ingestion of distance_miles and duration_minutes from Google Routes responses.
The system must verify via unit tests that proximity scores are computed using both distance and duration inputs.
The system must validate that normalized_score values are always bounded between 0 and 100 inclusive.
The system must confirm via tests that normalization is consistent across multiple trials within the same result set.
The system must include integration tests verifying that evaluate_care_facade returns proximity data in the clinical trial API response.
The system must validate that API responses include distance_miles, duration_minutes, normalized_score, and metadata fields for each trial.
The system must include a test case where distance_miles is zero and confirm the normalized_score reflects highest proximity.
The system must include a test case for long-distance outliers and confirm scores are proportionally reduced without breaking normalization.
The system must include an exception test where user location is missing and confirm the proximity score is not computed and is safely omitted or null.
The system must include an exception test where Google Routes data is unavailable and confirm fallback behavior does not crash the service.
The system must verify that proximity scoring logic produces deterministic outputs for identical inputs across test runs.
The system must include tests ensuring that trials without proximity data are still returned in API responses without breaking schema validation.
The system must validate that metadata fields such as route_source and timestamp are present and correctly typed in test outputs.
The system must ensure integration tests validate end-to-end flow from clinical_trials_service through evaluate_care_facade to API response.
The system must include LLM-facing response validation ensuring proximity data is structured consistently for downstream explanation generation.
